title: Our Share of Night
description: A monumental Gothic and political horror novel set during Argentina's military dictatorship. It follows a father and son fleeing a secret cult known as The Order.

title: How to Disappear Completely
description: A novel set during Argentina's 2001 economic crisis, portraying the life of a marginalized teenager struggling with a violent and suffocating family environment in the suburbs.

title: Kids Who Come Back
description: An unsettling supernatural horror story in which children who were once reported missing mysteriously begin to reappear in a town, unleashing confusion and fear.
